heat.normal_basis: Station normal: mean hours of mandated rest a worker for this calendar month, 2000 to 2024, from NEA WBGT where observed and corrected ERA5 rebuild elsewhere.

rain.normal_basis: Station normal: mean rain hours a worker for this calendar month, 2000 to 2024, estimated from the nearest MSS daily record (calibrated on 1513 station-days where NEA 5-minute gauges and MSS daily records overlap; missing MSS station-days, including before a local station began, use Changi on the same date).

haze.note: No allowance for haze. 20 h a year limit.

receipt_lines: Tanjong Greenworks Pte Ltd, October 2025. Heat station: Jurong West Stadium (S132). Rain gauge: Jurong West Street 73 (S228). Haze: west region PSI.
Heat rest owed: 0.67 h a worker. Normal month + 25%: 1.37 h. Insured: 0.00 h.
Heavy rain: 5.00 h a worker. Normal month + 25%: 7.03 h. Insured: 0.00 h.
Haze: 0.00 h. No allowance for haze.
0.00 h x S$8 x 20 workers = S$0, by PayNow to your UEN by Fri 07 Nov 2025 (5th working day).
Nothing is paid this month: it stayed within the normal range at your station, or the hours are still pending.
To dispute a reading, reply to this receipt. Disputes are data checks. You can also go to FIDReC.

not_counted.why: This is your declared unpaid meal hour, so it is not insured.
Within your normal month + 25% (1.37 h). Only hours above it are insured.

not_counted.what: Losses above S$8 a worker an hour
not_counted.why: Rehat pays a fixed benefit, not your actual loss.
